measure: Nominal and real government liability zero-coupon spot curves; derived RPI breakeven curve
units: Percent per annum, continuously compounded; maturity in years
releaseLag: Bank aims to publish by noon next business day; archive revised by close of second working day of month
transformation: Select GLC Nominal and GLC Real XLSX, whole spot-curve sheet 4. Preserve missing values as null and discard entirely empty non-trading dates. Merge each archive with current month, current taking precedence; retain 370 calendar days. RPI breakeven is nominal minus real continuously compounded spot yield at exactly matching dates and maturities, with no interpolation or nearest-date substitution. Missing tenors stay null.
status: validated; owner authorised attributed public non-commercial dashboard use

accessEvidence.result: Official nominal archive, real archive and latest ZIP successfully downloaded with project identified User-Agent; all three curve series validated and promoted for local use.

validation: Eleven parser and matching tests pass, including locally downloaded official workbook regression: derived nominal-minus-real matches published inflation spot cells to ten decimal places. Missing date/tenor observations cannot be manufactured.
licenceNote: Reviewed 9 September 2026: Database OGL coverage is explicit, while fitted-curve download reuse is not explicitly resolved by that clause. General terms allow personal/internal non-commercial use and say academic reuse is typically authorised. No specific BoE permission has been obtained; do not label this dataset OGL or claim permission from the Bank.
failure: Keep last verified payload and mark refresh failure; never replace spot curve with auction YTMs, OIS, forward curve or fabricated data.
attribution: Bank of England. Workbook source line: Bloomberg Finance L.P., Tradeweb and Bank calculations.
interpretation: Market inflation compensation includes inflation risk premia and liquidity effects; it is not a pure expectation or CPI forecast. RPI methods/data sources align with CPIH from February 2030; Bank notes that this may affect fitting around that horizon and has not changed its methodology.

reuseDecision.authorisation: Owner explicitly accepts the licensing uncertainty and authorises public non-commercial use with source recognition. This removes the project publication hold; it is an owner decision, not a legal determination or Bank permission.
reuseDecision.scope: Publish attributed fitted-curve outputs and dashboard calculations; retain original vendor-input/download workbook fixtures locally.
